column3: Steep limestone hills rise above red soil and fields at Viñales, Cuba.
column4: Viñales, Cuba. Karst erosion leaves steep mogotes above cultivated lowlands.

column3: Aerial view of Washington, DC, beside the Potomac River and National Airport.
column4: Washington, DC. The city occupies low ground beside the tidal Potomac River.

column3: Panoramic view of dunes, beach and water at Cape Henlopen, Delaware.
column4: Cape Henlopen, Delaware. Sand moves around the entrance to Delaware Bay.

column3: White chalk cliffs near Dover seen from the English Channel.
column4: Dover, Kent. Marine erosion exposes chalk deposited in an ancient sea.

column3: Landsat view of the thin Chandeleur barrier islands off Louisiana.
column4: Chandeleur Islands, Louisiana. Barrier islands separate the Gulf from shallow coastal waters and are vulnerable to storm erosion. Satellite colours emphasise land and water.

column3: A sandy inlet between rocky granite shores in Acadia National Park, Maine.
column4: Acadia, Maine. Waves act on a rugged coast underlain by resistant granite.

column3: Closely packed basalt columns on the Antrim coast at Giant's Causeway, Northern Ireland.
column4: Giant's Causeway, Northern Ireland. Cooling contraction formed joints in ancient basalt lava.

column3: Aerial view of Bodie Island, its lighthouse, wetlands and Atlantic beach in North Carolina.
column4: Bodie Island, North Carolina. A low barrier island separates Atlantic waves from sheltered wetlands.

column3: Rock, sandy beach and dunes on the Northumberland coast near Bamburgh.
column4: Northumberland coast. Dunes store wind-blown sand above a beach backed by resistant rock.

column3: Water falls over a sandstone ledge into a pool in Old Man's Cave Gorge, Ohio.
column4: Hocking Hills, Ohio. Water erodes the Black Hand Sandstone into gorges, ledges and plunge pools.

column3: Tilted rocky outcrops and breaking waves at Beavertail State Park, Rhode Island.
column4: Beavertail, Rhode Island. Atlantic waves erode an exposed rocky headland.

column3: The Huangpu River curves around Lujiazui's towers in Shanghai.
column4: Shanghai. Dense urban development occupies low delta ground beside the tidal Huangpu River.

column3: Floodwater surrounds Burrowbridge in the Somerset Levels in February 2014.
column4: Burrowbridge, Somerset, February 2014. Low relief slows the drainage of extensive floodwater.

column3: Mount Teide's volcanic slopes on Tenerife in Spain's Canary Islands.
column4: Tenerife, Spain. Teide records volcanic construction on an oceanic island; mainland Spain has a different geological setting.

column3: Night-time ISS photograph of Khartoum at the meeting of the Blue and White Nile in Sudan.
column4: Khartoum, Sudan. Settlement and lighting follow the confluence of the Blue and White Nile.

column3: A broad bend of the New River in a steep forested gorge in West Virginia.
column4: New River Gorge, West Virginia. River incision exposes the dissected Appalachian Plateau.
